Sandbox_PassiveSkills_SpawnChance_toolti: Chance that an eligible container (bookshelves, magazine racks, desks, postboxes, libraries, bookstores...) gets one skill magazine when its loot is generated. Lower volumes are more common. 0 = magazines never spawn. Default 12.
Sandbox_PassiveSkills_XpPercent_tooltip: 100 = reading the 5 volumes of a skill gives exactly the XP of level 5 (75/150/300/750/1500). Profession, trait and skill-book XP multipliers are ignored, so every character gains the same.
Sandbox_PassiveSkills_VHSSpawnChance_too: Independent chance of one original skill VHS in an eligible magazine container. 0 disables new VHS spawns; existing tapes remain playable. Default 2%. Vanilla tapes are unchanged.
Sandbox_PassiveSkills_VHSXpPercent_toolt: 100 = 250 base XP per complete tape (five teaching lines). Normal game XP multipliers and media level cutoff apply. Native cooldown/history rules apply. 0 disables learning without consuming unseen lines. Magazine XP is separate.
